title: Hypnosis with Dr. Michael O'Connell, trained by John Mack

tellings.quote: Um, a time and through hypnosis and a doctor from Harvard helping me.

plain: In 2007, in the Carolinas, Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had UFO experiences for years, says he went through hypnosis to work through what had happened to him. He tells Michels he had help from a doctor, Michael O'Connell, who is described as trained by John Mack, a Harvard doctor. If it is as he says, hypnosis helped bring his experiences to the surface.
